notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.text: The page you are looking for does not exist.

login.title: Sign in
login.intro: Enter your email address and we'll send you a link to sign in. No password needed.
login.sentText: We sent a sign-in link to {{email}}. It is valid for 15 minutes.
login.resendIn: Send a new link in {{seconds}} s
login.rateLimited: Too many requests. Try again in {{seconds}} s.
login.passkeyUnknown: This passkey is no longer valid. Sign in with an email link instead.
login.passkeyInvalid: The passkey could not be verified. Try again or sign in with an email link.

hero.tagline: Your favourites and dashboards, self-hosted and in one place.

dashboards.title: Dashboards
dashboards.description: Build start pages with links, sections and navigation trees right in the browser.

favourites.title: Favourites
favourites.description: Keep all your bookmarks in one tree of folders and links.

karakeep.title: Karakeep apps
karakeep.description: Save links from the Karakeep browser extensions and mobile apps.

common.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.

verify.title: Complete sign-in
verify.text: Confirm to sign in to Famodash in this browser.
verify.invalid: This sign-in link is invalid or has expired.

createFirst.title: Create your first dashboard
createFirst.text: Dashboards collect your links and widgets. Your default dashboard is shown right here.

selectDefault.title: Select your default dashboard
selectDefault.text: The default dashboard is shown here on your start page.
selectDefault.label: Default dashboard

profile.nameHint: Shown in the menu and on your start page instead of your email address.
profile.nameTooLong: The name can be at most 100 characters long.

passkeys.intro: Passkeys let you sign in with your fingerprint, face or device PIN instead of an email link.
passkeys.windowOpen: You signed in with an email link, so you can add passkeys for another
passkeys.windowClosed: To add a passkey, sign in with an email link first. You can then add passkeys for 5 minutes.
passkeys.unsupported: This browser doesn't support passkeys. Use another browser or device to add one.
passkeys.linkSent: We sent a sign-in link to {{email}}. Open it to add passkeys.
passkeys.linkRateLimited: Too many requests. Try again in a minute.
passkeys.addText: Give the passkey a name so you can recognize it later. Your browser will then ask you to create it.
passkeys.labelTooLong: The name can be at most 64 characters long.
passkeys.alreadyRegistered: This device or password manager already has a passkey for your account.
passkeys.emptyText: Add a passkey to sign in with one tap next time. Each device or password manager gets its own passkey.
passkeys.deleteText: You will no longer be able to sign in with “{{name}}”. You can still sign in with an email link.

favourites.title: Favourites
favourites.intro: All your links in one tree. Drag items by their handle to reorder them or move them into another folder.
favourites.dropAtEnd: Drop here to move to the top level
favourites.emptyText: Add a folder to group your links, or add your first link right away.

errors.nameTooLong: The name can be at most 100 characters long.
errors.urlInvalid: Enter a web address that starts with http:// or https://.
errors.urlTooLong: The URL can be at most 2048 characters long.
errors.titleTooLong: The title can be at most 1000 characters long.
errors.tagTooLong: Tags can be at most 100 characters long.
errors.notFound: This item no longer exists. The list has been refreshed.
errors.moveFailed: The item could not be moved. The list has been restored.

deleteDialog.linkText: “{{name}}” will be removed from your favourites.
deleteDialog.emptyFolderText: The empty folder “{{name}}” will be removed.
deleteDialog.folderText_one: “{{name}}” contains {{count}} item. What should happen to it?
deleteDialog.folderText_other: “{{name}}” contains {{count}} items. What should happen to them?
deleteDialog.deleteContents: Delete the folder and everything in it
deleteDialog.moveContents: Keep the contents and move them to “{{parent}}”

dnd.instructions: To move an item, press space or enter on its handle. Choose the new place with the up and down arrow keys, press space or enter to drop it, or escape to cancel.

dashboards.title: Dashboards
dashboards.intro: Every dashboard has its own address. Your default dashboard is your start page, and public dashboards can be opened by anyone with the link.

empty.title: No dashboards yet
empty.text: Create a dashboard to use it as your start page or to share it.

dialog.publicHint: Anyone with the address can see it, also without signing in.
dialog.titleTooLong: The title can be at most 100 characters long.
dialog.mobileColumnsTooMany: Use at most as many columns as on large screens.

deleteDialog.title: Delete dashboard?
deleteDialog.text: “{{title}}” will be deleted, and its address will stop working.

slug.invalid: Use 1 to 32 characters: a–z, 0–9 and hyphens.
slug.reserved: This address is reserved by Famodash. Please choose another one.
slug.renameHint: Links that use the old address will stop working.

confirmSlug.title: Change address?
confirmSlug.text: Links that use the old address will stop working. They are not redirected to the new one.

view.emptyText: Nothing has been added to this dashboard yet.
view.emptyOwnerText: Open the ⋯ menu and choose “Edit layout” to add the first section.

editor.saveFailed: The dashboard couldn't be saved. Please try again.
editor.conflict: This dashboard was changed elsewhere. Reload it to continue with the current version. Your changes here will be lost.
editor.tooDeep: Sections can be nested at most 5 levels deep.

sectionDialog.titleHint: Optional. Without a title, the section shows no heading.
sectionDialog.titleTooLong: The title can be at most 100 characters long.
sectionDialog.borderHint: Without a border, the section only groups its content.

deleteSection.title: Delete section?
deleteSection.textWithChildren_one: “{{title}}” and the section inside it will be deleted.
deleteSection.textWithChildren_other: “{{title}}” and the {{count}} sections inside it will be deleted.

discard.title: Discard changes?
discard.text: Your changes to this dashboard haven't been saved.

dnd.instructions: To move a section, press space or enter on its handle. Choose the new place with the arrow keys, press space or enter to drop it, or escape to cancel.
dnd.tooDeep: Position {{position}} in {{parent}}. Not possible: sections can be nested at most 5 levels deep.
